verdict.rationale: Metorial has a catalog of 1200+ integrations/pre-built providers and remote MCP servers that developers can attach to sessions, plus a Workforce/portal UI where users 'discover' approved integrations and skills, but there's no evidence of a searchable/browsable public registry with capability-based search or filtering before wiring into an agent — discovery is framed around admin-approved portals rather than open catalog search. missing for 10: a searchable catalog UI/API with capability-based filtering, evidence of browsing before integration setup, independent confirmation of catalog breadth/quality beyond the 1200+ claim.
